notes.title: Demo is available!
notes.content:
After 9 months of development, we are ready to present you our brainchild - Fury Race demo is available for public access!

Fury Race is a racing roguelite auto-shooter in a post-apocalyptic setting. You are one of the last survivors in a world destroyed by artificial intelligence. Fight hordes of speedy killer robots, improve your car and remember that death in Fury Race is just a lesson in survival.

[h2]Demo Notes[/h2]
The Demo features approximately 10% of the final content.

[h3]Demo Content[/h3]

The build contains several levels from different stages of the game, some weapons of varying rarity and about half of the ability cards. The meta-progression is limited to about an hour of play, but you can look for new ways to destroy enemies, experiment with the physics of the machine and unlock new combinations of guns. 

You can try the gameplay we offer and express your opinion in an e-mail to [url=mailto:dev@koro.games]dev@koro.games[/url] as well as in the discussions of the game [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2657300/discussions/]in the Steam community[/url].

[h3]Future plans[/h3]

The next stage of the game's development is Early Access. After we receive feedback from the demo version and make appropriate adjustments to the balance, content and stability of the game, we plan to hold a pre-release open beta with further development and bringing the game to a full release with community support.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2657300
